jobs.occupation: Stipendiat i innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring
jobs.description:
Om stillingene
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig opptil fire stillinger som stipendiat i innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring ved Handelshøgskolen UiS, Avdelingen for innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring. Stillingene er ledig fra august 2027.

Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir deg mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.

De som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i samfunnsvitenskap og forskerskolen i økonomiske og administrative fag (ECOBA). Programmet omfatter blant annet selvstendig forskningsarbeid, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø samt forskningsformidling. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.
 
Stillingene er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning eller fire år med forskerutdanning kombinert med annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Dette avklares i rekrutteringsprosessen.Som stipendiat blir du en del av et ambisiøst, tverrfaglig og internasjonalt orientert fagmiljø innenfor  innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring. Avdelingen er en av tre avdelinger ved Handelshøgskolen UiS med blant annet forskningssenteret Senter for innovasjonsforskning  og NHS Kompetansesenter er affiliert. Våre forskere publiserer i ledende internasjonale tidsskrifter og deltar i nasjonale og internasjonale forskningsprosjekter. Du får veiledning fra erfarne forskere, og gjennom forskerskolen ECOBA blir du del av et større ph.d.-fellesskap ved fakultetet. Vi samarbeider tett med nærings- og samfunnsliv i regionen og med forskningsmiljøer og legger til rette for forskningsopphold i utlandet i løpet av stipendiatperioden.
Forskningstema
Stillingene er knyttet til avdelingens tre fagområder: innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring. Du står fritt til å utvikle ditt eget doktorgradsprosjekt innenfor ett av fagområdene, eller i skjæringspunktet mellom dem. I søknaden ber vi deg oppgi hvilket fagområde prosjektet ditt hører hjemme i.Innen innovasjon er det aktuelt prosjekter innen 

• innovasjonspolitikk og innovasjonssystemer
• geografiske perspektiver på innovasjon
• omstilling og innovasjonsdrevet transformasjon 
Vi imøteser særlig prosjekter som anvender nye tilnærminger til koblede registerdata, tekstanalyse eller prosess-sporing. 

Innen ledelse er det aktuelt med prosjekter som utforsker ledelse, organisering og kommunikasjon i et arbeidsliv i endring, blant annet hvordan kunstig intelligens og digitalisering av arbeid bidrar til å forme arbeidsoppgaver, roller, beslutningsprosesser og ansettelsesforhold. 

Slike problemstillinger kan også knyttes til temaer som ansvarlig ledelse, mangfold og inkludering. Prosjektene kan bygge på ulike teoretiske perspektiver fra ledelses-, organisasjons- og arbeidslivsforskning, og benytte kvalitative, kvantitative eller kombinerte metodiske tilnærminger.

Innen markedsføring ønsker vi særlig prosjekter innen markedsstrategi og kvantitativ markedsføring. Søkere oppfordres til å utforske avdelingens forskningsprofil og pågående prosjekter for ytterligere informasjon og inspirasjon.
Prosjektskisse
Som søker skal du utarbeide en foreløpig prosjektskisse for et doktorgradsprosjekt innenfor aktuelt forskningstema. Skissen vil inngå i kompetansevurderingen.

Prosjektskissen skal redegjøre for prosjektets problemstilling, relevans, samt teoretisk og metodisk tilnærming. Det forventes at skissen er et selvstendig og originalt faglig arbeid som reflekterer dine egne vurderinger og idéer. Dersom kunstig intelligens er benyttet i arbeidet med prosjektskissen, skal dette opplyses om og bruken beskrives kort.

Dersom du blir ansatt, vil prosjektskissen og prosjektets framdriftsplan videreutvikles i samarbeid med veilederne i løpet av de tre første månedene av ansettelsesperioden og danne grunnlag for den endelige planen for doktorgradsprosjektet. Mal for prosjektskisse finner du her.
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad innenfor økonomi og administrasjon, innovasjon, ledelse, markedsføring eller annet relevant samfunnsvitenskapelig fag, eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning, fortrinnsvis av nyere dato. 

Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre. 

Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen. Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.

Dersom du fullfører mastergraden våren 2027, er du også velkommen til å søke.
 
Vi legger også vekt på at du:

• har høy faglig integritet og fokus på kvalitet i arbeidet
• er nysgjerrig og motivert for å gjennomføre forskningsprosjektet og bidra til faglige fellesskap og samarbeid på tvers av fagområder
• har potensial for forskning innenfor fagfeltet og personlige forutsetninger for å fullføre doktorgradsutdanningen innen ansettelses-perioden
• kan arbeide godt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre forskere
• har evne til kritisk refleksjon, nytenkning og selvstendig problemløsning, og arbeider strukturert og målrettet
• har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og bidrar til et konstruktivt arbeidsmiljø.
• har gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.Krav til engelskkunnskaper
Gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig, er en forutsetning for opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet. 

Dersom du er internasjonal søker og ikke omfattes av fritaksordningene nedenfor, må du dokumentere engelskkunnskapene dine med et gyldig resultat fra én av følgende språktester:

• TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT). Minimum resultat: 90/4.5
• IELTS – International English Language Testing Service. Minimum resultat: 6.5
• Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) eller Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) fra Universitetet i Cambridge
• PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic. Minimum resultat: 62
Du er fritatt fra kravet dersom du:

• har fullført minst ett års universitetsstudier i Australia, Canada, Irland, New Zealand, Storbritannia eller USA
• har fullført en mastergrad med engelsk som undervisningsspråk i et EU-/EØS-land eller i India
• er fritatt i henhold til HK-dirs GSU liste
• ikke inngår i de ovennevnte unntakskategoriene, men har bodd i Norge de siste fem åreneSom stipendiat ved UiS får du
• forskerutdanning ved et universitet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
• et ambisiøst og inkluderende forskningsmiljø
• veiledning og støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling
• gratis norskkurs dersom du ikke behersker norsk, svensk eller dansk på minimum A2-nivå ved ansettelse
• tilgang til Lifekeys, en digital tjeneste for mental helse og livskvalitet
• lønn som stipendiat etter Statens lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 1017, kr 580.000 brutto pr år, med lønnsutvikling etter ansiennitet i stillingen. 
• medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Les mer om ansattgoder og fordeler på uis.no.
Mangfold og inkludering
Mangfold er en styrke ved universitetet. Ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner bidrar til bedre løsninger og et godt arbeids- og læringsmiljø. Vi ønsker søkere med ulike kvalifikasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet. UiS legger til rette for ansatte i ulike livsfaser og for medarbeidere med behov for individuell tilrettelegging. 
 
I tråd med gjeldende regelverk vil minst én kvalifisert søker med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn bli invitert til intervju. Dersom dette gjelder deg, kan du oppgi det i jobbsøkerportalen. Les mer om ordningen her.  

Universitetet ønsker bedre kjønnsbalanse i stipendiatstillinger innenfor fagområdet og oppfordrer derfor særlig kvinner til å søke. Ved tilnærmet like kvalifikasjoner kan kvinner bli prioritert i samsvar med gjeldende regelverk.
Slik søker du
Søk stillingen ved å klikke på "Søk stillingen" på denne siden. 

I Jobbnorge registrerer du søknad, relevant utdanning og arbeidserfaring samt språkferdigheter. I søknaden ber vi deg beskrive dine forskningsinteresser, din motivasjon for stillingen og hvordan din bakgrunn er relevant for forskningsprosjektet.

Følgende dokumentasjon skal lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden:

• prosjektskisse, se mal tilgjengelig på våre nettsider
• CV med fullstendig oversikt over utdanning, erfaring og eventuell vitenskapelig virksomhet
• vitnemål med karakterutskrift som dokumenterer fullført mastergrad. Dersom du ikke har fullført mastergraden, skal du legge ved oppdatert karakterutskrift.
• Diploma Supplement eller tilsvarende dokumentasjon, samt konverteringsskala dersom dette er påkrevd
• dokumentasjon på engelskspråklig kompetanse dersom dette er påkrevd
• publikasjoner eller annet relevant forskningsarbeid
• attester og annen dokumentasjon som vurderes relevant for søknaden 
Dokumentasjonen må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. 

Søknaden vurderes på grunnlag av informasjonen som er registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristen utløp. Sørg derfor for at søknaden tydelig viser hvordan din kompetanse og erfaring oppfyller kompetansekravene i utlysningen, og at nødvendig dokumentasjon er lastet opp. Dersom vedleggene samlet overskrider 100 MB, må filene komprimeres før opplasting.

UiS behandler bare søknader og vedlegg registrert i Jobbnorge.

Opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om det er bedt om unntak fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil du bli varslet.
Ansettelsesvilkår og videre prosess
UiS er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det forventes at ansatte utviser sikkerhetsbevisst atferd, og følger gjeldende sikkerhets- og eksportkontrollrutiner. Ved ansettelse vil egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet bli vektlagt.

Ansettelse som stipendiat er regulert i universitets- og høgskoleforskriften kapittel IV. Opptak til doktorgradsutdanningen er regulert i forskrift for graden philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) ved Universitetet i Stavanger.

Dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen vil bli vurdert av en intern komité på grunnlag av dokumentasjonen registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristens utløp. På bakgrunn av komiteens vurdering vil aktuelle søkere bli invitert til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser for aktuelle kandidater. Les mer om ansettelsesprosessen på våre nettsider.
 
Doktorgradsarbeidet skal i hovedsak gjennomføres ved Universitetet i Stavanger. Det er en forutsetning at den som ansettes bosetter seg slik at vedkommende kan være til stede og tilgjengelig for fagmiljøet i ordinær arbeidstid.

Stillingen er kunngjort på både norsk og engelsk. Ved eventuelle motstridende opplysninger mellom tekstene er det den norske teksten som legges til grunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Stavanger (UiS) har omlag 12.000 studenter og 1.900 ansatte. Universitetet har store ambisjoner. Vi skal ha en innovativ og internasjonal profil og være en drivkraft i kunnskapsutviklingen og endringsprosesser i samfunnet. Vår felles retning skal drives frem av omtanke for bærekraftig omstilling og rettferdig samfunnsutvikling, gjennom nye måter å forvalte naturressursene på og legge til rette for bedre byer og lokalsamfunn. Energi, helse og velferd, læring for livet er våre satsingsområder.Den faglige virksomheten ved universitetet er organisert i seks fakultet med 13 institutt og to nasjonale forsknings- og kompetansesenter i tillegg til Arkeologisk museum. Vi er medlem i det europeiske nettverket for innovative universitet - European Consortium of Innovative Universities. Universitetet ligger i den mest attraktive regionen i landet med 300.000 innbyggere.  Stavangerregionen har et dynamisk arbeidsmarked og tilbyr en rekke spennende kultur- og fritidsaktiviteter.Sammen med våre ansatte og studenter vil vi løfte blikket, og våge å tenke stort og nytt – vi vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjente.

Handelshøgskolen UiS tilbyr bachelorutdanninger i økonomi og administrasjon og rettsvitenskap. I tillegg tilbys master i økonomi og administrasjon (siviløkonomutdanning), rettsvitenskap, regnskap og revisjon, erfarings-basert masterprogram rettet mot næringslivet (EMBA) samt forskerutdanning (PhD). Fakultetet legger til rette for utdanning, forskning og formidling innenfor en stor spennvidde av fag, som finans, markedsføring, organisasjon og ledelse, regnskap og revisjon, rettsvitenskap, strategi og økonomi. Universitetets Senter for innovasjonsforskning og Senter for entreprenørskap er organisatorisk plassert ved fakultetet. Pr i dag er omlag 120 ansatte og 1.400 studenter tilknyttet fakultetet. Handelshøgskolen ved UiS er organisert i tre avdelinger: Avdeling for innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring, Avdeling for regnskap og rettsvitenskap og Avdeling for samfunnsøkonomi og finans.

jobs.occupation: Tour Guide – Voss & the Fjords of Western Norway - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Trade a life of hustle and bustle for a summer in the Norwegian fjords and mountains. Meet guests from around the world, join our friendly international team and gain valuable experience while exploring spectacular landscapes, small communities and some of Norway’s most beautiful destinations.

Hva vi ser etter
Who We Are Looking For

If you are curious, service focussed, reliable and enjoy working closely amongst a team of individuals who enjoy connecting with people and working in a dynamic environment, then we are very interested in talking to you.

Requirements:

• 

Fluency in English and at least one, of the following languages: German, Spanish, Italian, French, Norwegian, Dutch or Chinese. Portuguese can also be an advantage. Proficiency in two or more of these languages in addition to English is considered a strong advantage.

• 

If you are not a Norwegian citizen, you must be an EU/EEA citizen or already have a valid Norwegian work permit.

• 

Interest in Norwegian history, culture, and nature.

• 

Guide Certification (or willingness to obtain one).

• 

Strong and demonstrable verbal communication skills are a huge advantage

• 

An experienced team player

Not Certified Yet?

As a part of our quality guarantee to our clients, our guides must hold at minimum a Guide Certification ensuring high professional standards. Several certification options are available in Norway.

We work together with and recommend the Guide Academy Certification Programme , which includes an engaging online course (completed remotely) and an intensive on-site training session in Voss starting April the 12th 2027.

No prior guiding experience is required, only passion and enthusiasm!

We sponsor the certification fee for candidates who commit to working a full season exclusively with Voss og Fjordane Guideservice.

Arbeidsoppgaver

What is working as a Guide in the Voss area like?

As a Tour Guide, you'll lead guests through some of Western Norway's most spectacular fjord and mountain landscapes.

Assignments range from scenic coach and fjord tours to ferry excursions, walking tours and hikes. You'll lead groups of up to 50 guests, share local stories and culture, and take responsibility for creating a safe, engaging and memorable experience.

The job is dynamic: schedules can change, and some tours will be repeated throughout the season. But every group is different, and there are also opportunities to work from other ports and experience more of Western Norway.

Vi tilbyr
What We Offer

• 

An international job in the heart of Fjord Norway - Experience a more authentic side of Norway, living and working among fjords, mountains, traditional villages and small local communities. Voss gives you a quieter base close to nature, while your assignments take you through some of Western Norway's most attractive destinations.

• 

A seasonal job with variety - Most assignments take place between May and mid-October, with additional guiding opportunities from April and into the later part of the year.

• 

Guaranteed minimum seasonal income - More predictability while still retaining the variety and flexibility that comes with guiding.

• 

Professional training and certification sponsorship - We'll help you gain professional qualifications and can sponsor your Guide Certification, including visits to destinations and venues throughout the region when you commit to a full season with us .

• 

Fair working conditions - We focus on creating a sustainable, inclusive and positive working environment. We provide full paid training on company specific procedures, tour logistics and guest service standards,

• 

Explore more of Fjord Norway - Your workplace extends far beyond Voss, with opportunities to guide in Flåm, Eidfjord, Ulvik, Vik, Odda, Rosendal and other destinations across the region. Assignments outside our normal region come with higher pay and paid travel time.

• 

Opportunities to grow - Guiding can be a first step into a wider career in tourism, hospitality and destination development.

Support with finding accommodation

Moving to Voss? We help make the move easier by arranging accommodation for most of our seasonal guides. This is subject to availability and at the guide's own expense. We can also provide guidance if you prefer to find your own place.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
About Voss og Fjordane Guide Service

The first official private guide service in Norway, with over 38 years of experience, Voss og fjordane Guideservice has a team of over 40 guides dedicated to creating exciting and meaningful experiences for guests visiting the fjord and mountain region of Western Norway.

Our philosophy is simple: when our guides are enthused, our guests will be as well -- enthusiasm is, after all, contagious! We spend much time developing and nurturing our team, ensuring that each guide can be a trusted leader, an exciting storyteller, a proud ambassador of the fjord region culture and a collaborative and engaging team member.

We deliver over 3,000 assignments every year, collaborating with over 90% of the cruise calls in some of the most beautiful cruise destinations in the country.

Our aim is to be the best we can be, and to get better every day!

jobs.occupation: Stipendiat i signalbehandling for medisinsk simulering
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig stilling som stipendiat i signalbehandling for medisinsk simulering ved Det teknisk- naturvitenskapelige fakultet, Institutt for data- og elektroteknologi. Stillingen er ledig fra våren 2027.

Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir deg mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.
 
Den som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i teknologi og naturvitenskap. Programmet omfatter blant annet selvstendig forskningsarbeid, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø samt forskningsformidling. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.

Stillingen er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning eller fire år med forskerutdanning kombinert med annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Dette avklares i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.
Forskningstema
Den som ansettes vil være tilknyttet forskningsprosjektet Cardiac Arrest Physiology Simulation (CAPS), der målet vårt er å utvikle en ny generasjon pasientsimulatorer for hjertestans.

Dette prosjektet har som mål å utvikle en realistisk pasientmodell for simulering av hjerte- og lungeredning (HLR) ved hjertestans, basert på faktiske opptak av gjenopplivingsforsøk. I motsetning til dagens forenklede simuleringsscenarioer, vil denne modellen gjenspeile den komplekse virkeligheten helsepersonell står overfor, der en rekke faktorer påvirker hvor utfordrende det er å gjenopplive en pasient.

Ved hjertestans kan hjertet befinne seg i ulike tilstander: enten rytmer som kan behandles med elektrisk støt (ventrikkelflimmer/ventrikkeltakykardi – VF/VT), eller rytmer som ikke kan behandles med støt (asystoli eller pulsløs elektrisk aktivitet – PEA, som kun behandles med grunnleggende HLR). Behandling av høy kvalitet kan føre til en positiv utvikling (f.eks. asystoli → VF → støt → PEA), mens behandling av lav kvalitet kan føre til en negativ utvikling. Modellen vil simulere disse overgangene mellom ulike tilstander, basert på kvaliteten på behandlingen som gis, samt pasientens egenskaper.

Prosjektet bygger videre på tidligere arbeid i forskningsgruppen vår, der vi har utforsket alternative modelleringsmetoder, primært innen signalbehandling og statistikk. Målet er å utvikle en pasientmodell som kan integreres i eksisterende pasientsimulatorer. Dette vil gi mer realistiske treningsscenarioer, som bedre forbereder helsepersonell på kompleksiteten i virkelige hjertestanssituasjoner. Videre skal de utviklede algoritmene implementeres i pasientsimulatorer fra Laerdal Medical – en global aktør innen medisinsk simulering og utstyr for akuttmedisin.

jobs.occupation: Field Application Engineer
jobs.description:
At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. We only hire the best. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.

About the role
We’re scaling fast, and to meet growing demand from both customers and internal teams, we’re expanding our Field Application Engineering team. Today, we are seven engineers split into two focused units: one driving internal testing and system validation, the other leading customer-facing work like demos, onboarding, and training. Together, this team is responsible for one thing above all else: making sure our technical works where it actually matters.

As a Field Application Engineer at Six Robotics, you sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and operators. You’ll take cutting-edge autonomy software out into the field, where constraints are real, stakes are high, and feedback is immediate. What you learn in the field directly shapes what we build next.

The role requires extensive travel (approximately 150 days per year), both nationally and internationally. This is not a desk role. You will spend most of your time in the field, working side-by-side with operators, testing systems under real conditions, troubleshooting when things don’t go as planned, and making sure every deployment delivers real operational value.

What you will do
• 
Own customer integrations: take part in technical pre-sales, lead onboarding, capture requirements, and ensure our swarm software is seamlessly integrated and fully operational.

• 
Turn needs into plans: create integration steps, checklists, and test procedures that guide both customers and our teams.

• 
Run field tests: plan and execute acceptance tests and trials, analyze telemetry, and feed results back into product and engineering.

• 
Troubleshoot issues: diagnose and resolve problems across hardware, firmware, networking, and software, often in time-critical situations.

• 
Deliver customer demos: plan and execute high-quality demos that communicate the value of our technology to customers and partners.

• 
Train and onboarding users: ensure operators understand how to use our systems effectively through structured training and hands-on support.

• 
Document and scale: build playbooks, runbooks, and internal best practices to support customers and future field engineers.

• 
Be the technical face in the field: act as the bridge between customers, operators, and internal teams, ensuring alignment and continuous improvement.

What we are looking for
We’re looking for a Field Application Engineer who is as comfortable in front of people as they are working hands-on with complex systems in the field. You are outgoing, robust, and adaptable, someone who thrives in dynamic environments where plans change and challenges arise. You bring structure to complexity, communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and take ownership from problem to solution.

You’re a creative problem solver who isn’t afraid to get your hands dirty, whether that means debugging systems in the field, setting up hardware, or working through unexpected issues under pressure. At the same time, you are confident in explaining complex concepts, building customer trust, and representing Six Robotics externally.

To be a strong fit for the role, we believe you:

• 
Have a strong technical foundation: ability to set up, configure, and troubleshoot complex systems across networking, hardware, and software.

• 
Are structured and reliable: capable of managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and field activities without losing clarity or momentum.

• 
Is an excellent communicator: able to explain complex technical concepts to operators, customers, and internal teams.

• 
Are hands-on and proactive: you take initiative, solve problems end-to-end, and are comfortable working directly with hardware and systems in the field.

• 
Are willing to travel extensively: able and motivated to spend around 150 days per year in the field, both nationally and internationally.

• 
Are fluent in English; Norwegian is a strong advantage. German or French is a plus.

In addition to the above, experience with UAVs, robotics, defence, or similar complex systems would be valuable. Familiarity with military organizations or prior field-based, customer-facing technical work is a plus. Basic programming skills or the ability to read code would also be beneficial.

Why you should join
At Six Robotics, we build systems that work when it matters the most. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

• 
Contribute to a mission with urgency: Help build autonomy that protects nations and deters conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. The problems are real, the stakes are high, and the need is now.

• 
Take ownership from day one: You’ll be trusted with real responsibility early, with the autonomy to move fast and solve hard problems without unnecessary layers.

• 
Build from zero, shape the future: Join early and help shape the systems, tools, and ways of working as we scale. What you build is used in real operations, with a short and clear feedback loop between your work and its impact.

• 
Work with purpose, supported by great benefits: Be part of a team of smart, driven, and engaged individuals who take pride in their work and push each other to improve. We offer competitive compensation, equity potential, and solid insurance and pension plans.

Our recruitment process
We aim to keep our process short and sweet, but also thorough. As a small team, every hire matters, and we can’t afford to get this one wrong.

Here’s what to expect:

• 
Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min).

• 
Meet & Greet with someone from the team to get to know each other better (60 min).

• 
Structured case interview to understand role fit and potential (90 min).

• 
Final interview with Head of People to assess cultural fit (45 min).

• 
Reference check followed by an offer if everything goes well.

We will review applications on an ongoing basis.

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance (Sikkerhetsklarering) due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. Prior clearance is not required; the process begins as part of onboarding. As part of this process, eligibility is limited to candidates holding citizenship from EU and NATO member countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations.

We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

About the Role
The Norwegian Meteorological Institute has an open position as Researcher. The position is affiliated with the Ocean and Ice Division in the Ocean Department, and is based in Tromsø. The Ocean and Ice Division develops and operates numerical models for forecasting of ocean currents, hydrography, sea level, waves and sea-ice. These models provide input to downstream services such as oil spill drift models and search-and-rescue support. The work is carried out in collaboration with national and international partners.

The work involves the management of operational forecast systems, including coordination of research staff, project administration, and supervision of research activities. The candidate is expected to contribute in the development of the division's research portfolio according to the institute strategy and actively seeks external project funding. Furthermore, the successful candidate will be expected to coordinate and manage inter-institutional activities that MET Norway is partnering in. It is essential that you can work efficiently in a team environment both within MET Norway and in an inter-institutional framework.
 
Among the tasks that the successful candidate will become involved in, is management of MET Norway's responsibilities in the Arctic Monitoring and Forecasting Centre (ARCMFC) of the Copernicus Marine Service. ARCMFC is coordinated by the Nansen Environmental and Remote Sensing Center, and also includes the Institute of Marine Research, Norway and the Danish Meteorological Institute. Met Norway's main responsibilities in ARCMFC are wave modelling, near real time forecasts for ocean circulation and sea ice, management and monitoring of communications with the service central dissemination unit at Copernicus, and monitoring of product quality.

The successful candidate will act as a link between the Ocean and Ice Division, the Fram Centre in Tromsø, and ARCMFC and become involved in regional high resolution ocean and sea ice modelling for our national service, notably the application of ARCMFC results for this service. Probabilistic forecasting is of particular interest in this context.

jobs.description:
About the position
We invite applications for a three-year PhD Research Fellow position in experimental proton therapy, available at the Department of Physics, University of Oslo (UiO).

The preferred starting date is March 1, 2027, and no later than April 1, 2027.The fellowship period is 36 months.

The position is part of InnovaRTBRAIN – Innovative Radiation Therapy for Brain Tumors, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network (MSCA-DN) funded by the European Union. The network brings together leading European research institutions, hospitals, and industrial partners to develop innovative radiation therapy approaches for brain tumors, with particular emphasis on glioblastoma.The successful candidate will be recruited as Doctoral Candidate 13 (DC13) and will join the proton therapy research group at the Department of Physics, University of Oslo and the Department of Radiation Biology, Oslo University Hospital (OUS).

Most of the experimental research will be carried out at the proton therapy facility at Oslo University Hospital, which provides state-of-the-art infrastructure for preclinical proton irradiation, including a dedicated research beamline and gantry, a 3T small-animal MRI scanner, and facilities for experimental radiobiology.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 
Background of the project
Glioblastoma is one of the most aggressive forms of brain cancer, with limited treatment options and poor prognosis. Radiation therapy plays a central role in its treatment, but its effectiveness is restricted by tumor radioresistance and the sensitivity of surrounding healthy brain tissue.

Proton minibeam radiation therapy (pMBRT) is an emerging approach in which radiation is delivered in narrow, spatially separated beams, producing a highly heterogeneous dose distribution. This technique has the potential to reduce radiation-induced damage to healthy tissues while maintaining effective tumor irradiation. However, its biological effects, particularly the evolution of tumor and normal tissue responses over time, remain incompletely understood. 
 
The PhD project will investigate the biological response to proton minibeam irradiation in preclinical models of brain cancer, using longitudinal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and quantitative image analysis. The project will also explore the potential of MRI-derived biomarkers for assessing treatment response and normal tissue effects. An important part of the research will be conducted in close collaboration with another doctoral candidate in InnovaRTBRAIN (DC6), based at Oslo University Hospital, who will investigate combinations of radiation therapy and immunotherapy, including CAR-T cell treatment.
Job description 
The doctoral candidate will conduct experimental studies in mouse models to investigate tumor and normal tissue responses to proton minibeam radiation therapy, using magnetic resonance imaging and other methods to characterize radiation-induced biological effects.The main responsibilities will be:

• Plan and conduct preclinical proton minibeam irradiation experiments in mouse models
• Acquire and analyze MRI data, including diffusion-weighted imaging, to quantify treatment response and potential normal tissue toxicity
• Relate MR-derived image parameters to radiation dose distributions, linear energy transfer (LET), and biological endpoints
• Develop and apply quantitative image analysis and radiomics methods to identify imaging features associated with tumor response and radiation injury
• Investigate MRI-based biomarkers in combination with NMR-derived metabolic and relaxation-time markers, in collaboration with international project partners
• Collaborate with DC6 on preclinical studies combining proton minibeam radiation therapy and immunotherapy
• Participate in joint research, training activities, and research visits within the InnovaRTBRAIN doctoral network Research environment
The candidate will join an interdisciplinary research environment combining radiobiology, medical physics, experimental proton therapy, and medical imaging. The research will be conducted in close collaboration between the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital, primarily at the proton therapy research facility at the Norwegian Radium Hospital. The facility provides access to experimental proton irradiation, a dedicated small-animal MRI scanner, treatment planning software, and infrastructure for preclinical cancer research.
Supervisors and international collaboration
The doctoral candidate will be supervised by Professor Eirik Malinen (UiO/OUS), with co-supervision from Professor Nina Edin (UiO), Professor Paul Vasos (University of Bucharest), and Else Marit Inderberg (OUS). The InnovaRTBRAIN network will provide an international and interdisciplinary training environment, combining expertise in medical physics, radiobiology, imaging, cancer biology, and immunotherapy.
Planned secondments
As part of the InnovaRTBRAIN doctoral network, the candidate will undertake research visits to international academic and industrial partners:

• University of Bucharest, Romania (3 months): Integration of NMR-based biomarkers with MRI-derived radiomics to characterize tumor responses.
• Xstrahl, UK (2 weeks): Training in small-animal irradiation technologies and their applications in preclinical radiation therapy research.
• COSYLAB, Slovenia (2 weeks): Exposure to industrial developments in radiation therapy technology and control systems.
These secondments will provide complementary scientific and technical training and strengthen collaboration within the InnovaRTBRAIN network.

jobs.description:

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
Are you interested in pursuing a doctoral degree in an international research environment? This position offers the opportunity to join the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network GLASS-CARE, collaborate with academic, museums, and industry partners across Europe, and develop expertise within a multidisciplinary research project on cultural heritage science.

As part of the GLASS-CARE network, the PhD Candidate will participate in workshops, conferences, transferable skills training, and research secondments with partner organisations. The position provides opportunities for both academic and professional development within an international setting.

The successful candidate will be offered a fixed-term, full-time position as a PhD Candidate for a period of 36 months and will be enrolled in a PhD programme leading to the award of a doctoral degree. The expected start date is 1 August 2027, and the Head of the unit will be the immediate supervisor for employment-related matters.
About the project
About the GLASS-CARE project GLASS-CARE (Green Light for Advanced Solutions in Stained-glass Conservation and Application of Research and Education) is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network that brings together leading European universities, research institutions, and industry partners to train the next generation of heritage scientists. The project focuses on understanding, documenting, and monitoring change in cultural heritage using advanced technologies, including imaging, materials analysis, artificial intelligence, and data science. Through an interdisciplinary and international research environment, GLASS-CARE equips doctoral candidates with the skills needed to address current and future challenges in cultural heritage conservation and preservation. For more details, visit http://www.glasscare.eu/

About the DC projectWithin the GLASS-CARE project, the individual research project associated with this position (DC13) is entitled Multi-sensor data fusion for digital representation.

The PhD project will investigate computational approaches for integrating data acquired through hyperspectral imaging (HSI), multispectral imaging (MSI), X-ray fluorescence (XRF), and photoacoustic techniques.

The resulting computational framework will contribute to improved material characterization, condition assessment, and conservation decision-making for historical stained glass.The PhD candidate will address the following objectives (1) Multimodal data integration (2) Multimodal registration, alignment and data fusion (3) Feature extraction and dimensionality reduction (4) Unified digital representations (6) Validation through case studies.

Expected results: (1)  A computational framework for integrating heterogeneous imaging and analytical data into unified digital representations of stained glass. (2) Advanced data fusion methods to minimize redundancy, preserve complementary information, and reveal hidden patterns across different imaging modalities. (3) Deliver validated computational models and tools for improved material characterization, visualisation, condition assessment, and conservation decision-making. 
Duties of the position
• Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate.
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above.
• Academic publications and popular science dissemination.
• Participate in the Colourlab research group.
• Participate in the network’s joint research and training activities, both online and in person pacross the GLASS-CARE partner institutions and contribute to GLASS-CARE project deliverables in accordance with the Description of Action and the project's governance procedures.
• Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions. Particularly, secondments of a few months’ duration are foreseen to project partners in University of Antwerpen-UA Belgium, Nova University Lisbon – UNL Portugal, and Swiss National Museum-SNM Switzerland.
• Other career-promoting work
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must have experience with image acquisition and analysis.
• Excellent programming skills.
• At the date of recruitment, you must NOT have been awarded a doctoral degree. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis but have not yet formally been awarded the degree are also not eligible.

• Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.

If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
• You must comply with the MSCA mobility rule: you must not have resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the recruiting organisation for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before recruitment (short stays such as holidays are not taken into account). 
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• Knowledge of and experience with spectral imaging. 
• Knowledge of and experience with data fusion.
• Knowledge of and experience in conservation science will be an added advantage. 
• Experience working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment.
• Programming skills in Python/Matlab.
• Excellent analytical and communication skills.
• Ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary environment.Personal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Have a high level of personal responsibility, initiative, motivation and ability to work in a project team as well as independently. 
• Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them.
• Present and discuss your research with other professionals.

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer

• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

Salary and conditions

If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

Evaluation processApplications will be assessed by an expert committee based on the qualifications and documentation submitted by the applicants. The evaluation will consider academic achievements, the quality and relevance of the applicant's educational background, research potential, and suitability for the position. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview. The final appointment will be made in accordance with the applicable regulations for employment at the university.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.
